		tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_2_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_PERCENT_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_produced_2_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_VALUE_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_traded_2_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_VALUE_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_supply_2_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_VALUE_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_demand_2_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_VALUE_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_score_3_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_VALUE_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes
		}
		tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_3_slaves_goods = {
			format = "TV_TRADE_MONOPOLY_PERCENT_FORMAT"
			min = 0
			start = 0
			hidden = yes

		tv_trade_consumer_produced_3_slaves_goods = {

			min = 0

			hidden = yes
		}
	}

	monthly_effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_has_leader = yes
					leader_country ?= {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_GRAND_MERCHANT_CHAR_TT
							has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
						}
						var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
						tv_grand_merchant_available_for_monopoly_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				tv_trade_league_update_monopolies_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				tv_trade_league_suspend_virtual_demands_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	can_join_trigger = {
		is_subject = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_NOT_IN_TRADE_LEAGUE_TT
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_creation = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:actor }
			set_leader_country = scope:actor
		}
	}

	on_joined = {
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}

	on_left = {
		remove_variable = tv_trade_league_member
	}

	create_visible_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	invite_visible_trigger = {
		always = no
	}
}
